forearmCollision.applicability: Exact body SHA only; regenerate for shape morph or different body. Runtime uniform scale scales lengths/radii; nonuniform scaling requires ellipsoid handling.

forearmCollision.representation: Piecewise linear radius on t=0..1 centerline plus spherical elbow and wrist caps. Each slab radius bounds every vertex of every selected triangle intersecting it. limits: Bind-space selected triangles are conservatively enclosed; arbitrary posed blend deformation is not proven enclosed.

No fixed 8mm clearance baked into measured envelope; integration chooses explicit garment clearance separately.
